claim: Do not test carry after LDWS: the book gives it INC D's flags (carry kept), the 3.02.00 board gave ADD D,1's (carry set when D was $FF). ADD rr,A is settled: it clears carry.
limit: Open for LDWS only, until a board on a later core settles it (nxsuite Z01 / Z03). The LEARNINGS line on ADD rr,A keeping CF is about CSpect, not a board.

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 2
evidence.text: ADD rr,A adds A unsigned, wraps past FFFF and clears carry even on a wrap, other flags kept; ADD rr,nn leaves every flag; LDWS takes the flags of INC D.
LDWS: flags of ADD D,1 (CF = D was $FF), not INC D's kept carry; ADD rr,A cleared CF (NEXT_REGISTERS.md:117).
